managedWhitelist.title: Organization whitelist
managedWhitelist.description: Domains that are always whitelisted, e.g. "example.com" or "*.sharepoint.com". Users cannot remove them.

allowUserWhitelist.title: Allow users to whitelist their own domains
allowUserWhitelist.description: If false, only the organization whitelist applies and users cannot add domains. Default: true.

enablePreemptiveChecks.title: Preemptive domain checks
enablePreemptiveChecks.description: Forces the confirmation page for non-whitelisted domains on or off. If unset, users decide.

enableCountryBlock.title: Country checks
enableCountryBlock.description: Forces the country lookup on or off. If unset, users decide.

blockedCountries.title: Blocked countries
blockedCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "RU") that are always blocked.

noticeText.title: Note on the confirmation page
noticeText.description: Text shown to users on the confirmation page, e.g. whom to contact when in doubt.

geoProvider.title: Lookup service for country checks
geoProvider.description: "ipwhois" or "geojs" (both HTTPS) or "ipapi" (unencrypted HTTP). If unset, users decide.

protectedEmailDomains.title: Company e-mail domains
protectedEmailDomains.description: E-mail domains of the organization, e.g. "example.com". Typing an address of such a domain on a non-whitelisted page shows a warning at the field.

protectedLogins.title: Additional sign-in names of the user
protectedLogins.description: Optional, set per user: further names (e.g. the logon name) that trigger the same warning.

enableWarningBar.title: Warning bar
enableWarningBar.description: Forces the red warning bar on non-whitelisted pages on or off. If unset, users decide.

warningBarSize.title: Height of the warning bar
warningBarSize.description: "slim" (one small line, default) or "normal". If unset, users decide.
